spoken_text: Today we look at ahead-of-time compilation, where Java code is compiled before it runs. The result is a native executable that does not need a JVM to start.
slide_text:
Ahead-of-time compilation
From bytecode to a native executable

spoken_text: The big win is startup time. A service can be ready in milliseconds. Memory use also drops, because there is no JIT compiler running next to your code.
slide_text:
Startup and memory
Milliseconds instead of seconds

spoken_text: There are trade-offs. Builds take longer, and reflection needs extra configuration. For long-running services the JIT can still reach higher peak performance.
slide_text:
Trade-offs
Build time, reflection, peak performance
